Commentary.Commentary: We are back to the run chase! Hazratullah Zazai and Rahmanullah Gurbaz are out in the middle and will face Muhammad Jawadullah with the new ball. Let's play!
...THE RUN CHASE...

Afghanistan would be happy to stop UAE on 166 after a scintillating initiation of the innings by the latter. UAE would be disappointed as their middle order failed to contribute with the bat. The question now looms, will the hosts restrict the visitors below 166 or will Afghanistan seal the series and repeat what they did earlier this year? Stick with us for an engaging run chase in the second half.

Afghanistan on the flip side was taken aback by the initial onslaught by Waseem and Lakra. They failed to take a single wicket within the powerplay and conceded 55 runs. But Qais Ahmad came to the rescue and picked two scalps in no time by dismissing the well-settled Waseem and Vriitya Aravind. The bowlers dented the opposition's middle order as Azmatullah Omarzai sooner joined the party and picked two wickets in two deliveries and turned the tide well towards the visitors. Fazalhaq Farooqi too, chipped in with a wicket and was pretty economical. But the visitors were too sloppy in the fielding, even going by their standards, and conceded unnecessary runs.

That brings us to the end of the first innings of this 2nd T20I and it's been an interesting first half. The hosts started off pretty well with the skipper Muhammad Waseem taking the charge from the front in the powerplay. He was aggressive and struck a fifty in no time within the powerplay itself. He was partnered Aryan Lakra who steadied the innings as they both stitched up a crucial opening stand of 72 runs. Vriitya Aravind, Basil Hameed, and Tanish Suri were back in the hut in quick succession. Akif Raja hit a couple of quick boundaries down the order. Aryan Lakra stayed unbeaten and scored 63 helping them to reach a respectable total. UAE finished on 166.
Only a single to end the innings! Naveen-ul-Haq lands this on hard length and on off, Aryan Lakra backs away and stabs it wide of point for a run. United Arab Emirates finishes on 166/7!

Commentary.Commentary: We are all set to begin! The players are making their way out in the middle now. Muhammad Waseem and Aryan Lakra are the two openers out in the middle for United Arab Emirates and Fazalhaq Farooqi is with the new ball and is raring to go for Afghanistan.

Ibrahim Zadran, the captain of Afghanistan says that they would have bowled first. Adds that this is a lucky call for them as they batted first in the last game and want to test their bowling. Tells that the first game of any series is always important. Mentions that they always look to enjoy out in the middle and they are hoping to seal the series in this game. Informs there is one change as Darwish Rasooli comes in for Karim Janat.

Muhammad Waseem, the skipper of United Arab Emirates says that they will bat first as the pitch is looking good for batting. He says that they will look to get a good total. Adds that 150-160 looks like a good total. Appreciate Rahmanullah Gurbaz who played really well in the first game but that's in the past now. Three changes in the team Samal Udawaththa, Khalid Shah, and Nilansh Keswani are not playing. Aryan Lakra, Dhruv Parashar, and Akif Raja are in the side.

Afghanistan (Playing XI) - Rahmanullah Gurbaz (WK), Hazratullah Zazai, Ibrahim Zadran (C), Azmatullah Omarzai, Najibullah Zadran, Mohammad Nabi, Darwish Rasooli (In place of Karim Janat), Qais Ahmad, Noor Ahmad, Naveen-ul-Haq, Fazalhaq Farooqi.

United Arab Emirates (Playing XI) - Muhammad Waseem (C), Aryan Lakra (In place of Khalid Shah), Vriitya Aravind, Tanish Suri (WK), Basil Hameed, Dhruv Parashar (In place of Samal Udawaththa & On Debut), Ali Naseer, Aayan Khan, Muhammad Jawadullah, Akif Raja(In place of Nilansh Keswani).
TOSS - United Arab Emirates have won the toss and elected to BAT first.

On the flip side, the United Arab Emirates is fueled with motivation to reverse its fortunes following the recent defeat. Despite a great bowling spell by Aayan Afzal Khan in the first innings and the standout performance by Vriitya Aravind with the bat in the second innings, the hosts fell way too short. The UAE squad will now be geared up and aim to confront the Afghanistan team with renewed vigour in a bid to level the series at 1-1. Could we be in for an upset, witnessing the underdogs breaking free from constraints on this New Year's Eve? Or will Afghanistan conclude the year on a triumphant note, securing the series under their name? Live action coming your way shortly!

Afghanistan enter this match brimming with confidence and riding the wave of momentum following a convincing victory in the series opener. The stand-out performances by centurion Rahmanulla Gurbaz and skipper Ibrahim Zadran with the bat and the overall bowling effort compounded the challenges for the home team. As a result, the hosts faced a daunting task, left with a substantial deficit of 72 runs at the conclusion of the 20 overs.

Hello, and a warm welcome to all the viewers across the globe as we gear up for the second T20I of this 3-match series between Afghanistan and the United Arab Emirates on the eve of New Year's at the beautiful Sharjah Cricket Stadium.
… MATCH DAY …

After a dominating victory in the first game, Afghanistan will be keen to replicate their performance and wrap the series up with a gane to spare. Rahmanullah Gurbaz lit up Sharjah with a scintillating hundred that set up the game for them while skipper Ibrahim Zadran also notched up a fine fifty.  However, they will expect a bit more from Hazratullah Zazai who made his comeback in international cricket and will be eager to make a mark. They have the veteran, Mohammad Nabi along with Azmatullah Omarzai and Karim Janat who packs a punch down the order and all of them has shown that in recent times as well. Their bowling was solid as well with both pacers, Fazalhaq Farooqi and Naveen-ul-Haq getting them early breakthroughs and will look to do more of the same. Azmatullah Omarzai is another option who can extract some bounce and pace from the wicket. In the absence of Rashid and Mujeeb, Noor Ahmad and Qais Ahmad takes responsibility of the spin department and they also played their part perfectly in the first match. It is a complete performance from them against the hosts. United Arab Emirates, on the other hand, were outplayed by the Afghans in all three departments and couldn't show any fight. Vriitya Aravind was the lone warrior who registered a fifty but no one else was able to support him. Muhammad Waseem and Khalid Shah failed to get them to a good start which is crucial chasing big totals and they will want to improve in this game. Samal Udawaththa looked a bit unsettled making his debut but the other debutant, Tanish Suri was unfazed by the situation and batted decently. Their bowling though, needs a lot of improvement as they were pretty inconsistent and conceded too many runs. Junaid Siddique needs to lead the pace attack using his experience more while Muhammad Jawadullah can play good support to him. Aayan Khan was one of the only positives in the first game and will be key again while Nilansh Keswani and Ali Naseer will hope to better their performances in this game. Will United Arab Emirates be able to level the series? Or will Afghanistan take it home? We will find out soon.
